name: add_tests_java_days_in_month
description: Write plain-java tests for daysInMonth/isLeapYear; java-native harness (century-rule, feb-never-leaps, august-30 mutants)
prompts: CalendarUtil in CalendarUtil.java (already correct - do not modify it) has isLeapYear(year) implementing the full Gregorian rule (divisible by 4, except centuries unless divisible by 400) and daysInMonth(year, month) returning 28/29 for February accordingly, 30 for Apr/Jun/Sep/Nov, 31 otherwise, throwing IllegalArgumentException for months outside 1-12. Write a plain-Java test class at exactly CalendarUtilTest.java (public static void main, throw AssertionError on mismatch, no JUnit) covering at least: February in a normal leap year (e.g. 2024), the century exception (1900 -> 28), the 400-year exception (2000 -> 29), a 30-day month AND a 31-day month from the second half of the year (August and November are the classic confusions), and that month 0 or 13 throws. The class must exit normally when everything passes.
